$comment: Template for .sync-state.json at the repo root. Committed per-branch. Edit the real file, not this one.

$field_notes.branch_mode: release on `main` branch, nightly on `nightly` branch.
$field_notes.base_release_tag: The parent release tag this branch builds atop. Same on both branches — main has shipped this version live, nightly is accumulating drafts on top of it.
$field_notes.base_release_sha: Parent commit SHA at base_release_tag. The release both branches build on; prepare.mjs uses it for the cumulative figures in PENDING.md.
$field_notes.last_seen_parent_sha: The parent commit (quarantine pin) the last nightly run documented. The next nightly window starts here, so it must be an ancestor of the next pin.
$field_notes.last_applied_manifest_hash: Fingerprint (sha256) of the last window's commit list, written from prepare.json's next_state.
